title: Velvety Rich French Pumpkin Gratin
description: A rich and comforting French dish featuring pumpkin, apple cider vinegar, and a touch of fermentation, perfect for a cozy dinner. This macrobiotic-friendly gratin is made with wholesome ingredients and is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the pumpkin and onion with the olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the pumpkin mixture in a 9x13 inch baking dish and roast for 30 minutes.
While the pumpkin is roasting, saute the garlic in a little bit of olive oil until fragrant.
In a blender or food processor, combine the roasted pumpkin, sauteed garlic, apple cider vinegar, and nutritional yeast, and blend until smooth.
Stir in the fermented cashew cream and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pumpkin mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional nutritional yeast if desired.
Bake for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
